placeholderTitle: A second perspective, quietly taking shape.
placeholderBody: This is the beginning of a private, local space for noticing how your experiences connect over time.

database.error: Local storage could not be initialized

capture.composeBody: Write naturally. Nothing becomes structured long-term data until you review it and choose Save.
capture.naturalInputPlaceholder: Describe what happened, what you noticed, or what went through your mind…
capture.temporaryNote: This original text is temporary review context and is not saved.
capture.originalTextNote: Use this as a reference. Only the fields you confirm below will be saved.
capture.contextPrompt: What was happening? What was the context? (optional)
capture.observationPrompt: What did you actually see, hear, or experience?
capture.thoughtPrompt: What went through your mind at the time?
capture.emptyValidation: Add at least one context, experienced detail, or thought. Remove any blank added fields.

errors.emptyCapture: Add at least one item before saving.
errors.invalidSituation: The context could not be saved. Check the text and try again.
errors.invalidObservation: One experienced detail could not be saved. Check it and try again.
errors.invalidThought: One thought could not be saved. Check it and try again.
errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. No new information was saved.
errors.captureConflict: This capture conflicts with an existing local record. No partial information was saved.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local storage is not ready. No information was saved.
errors.clockUnavailable: The current time is unavailable. No information was saved.
errors.saveFailed: The capture could not be saved. No partial information was kept.

history.title: Saved contexts, experienced details, and thoughts
history.scope: This view shows these three kinds of structured records. It is not a complete view of all data NOUS holds.
history.order: Newest saved first within each section. Save order does not represent when events occurred.
history.empty: No saved contexts, experienced details, or thoughts yet.
history.standaloneObservations: Experienced details without a saved context
history.conviction: How strongly you believed this thought at the time: {value}/100

errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent, so no saved records were loaded.
errors.dataInconsistent: Some saved records are inconsistent, so this view could not be loaded safely.
errors.loadFailed: Saved records could not be loaded.

correction.title: Correct inaccurate record
correction.explanation: Use this when NOUS stored this record inaccurately. If your view changed later, add a new record instead of rewriting the past. This does not delete the record.
correction.conviction: How strongly you believed this thought at the time (optional, 0–100)
correction.priorMeaning: Previous values are inaccurate NOUS representations, not true past user states. Context labels identify logical saved contexts using their current wording.

errors.targetNotFound: This saved record could not be found. No correction was saved.
errors.invalidCorrection: Check the corrected content, context, and conviction value.
errors.noChanges: The corrected representation is unchanged. No correction was saved.
errors.staleCorrection: This record changed after you opened it. Reload before confirming a correction.
errors.evidenceReferenceBlocked: This record is already used as a deliberate evidence source, so it cannot be corrected here. No changes were saved.
errors.subjectInvariant: The local user record is inconsistent. No correction was saved.
errors.dataInconsistent: Saved records are inconsistent. No correction was saved.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local storage is not ready. No correction was saved.
errors.correctionConflict: The correction conflicted with local data. No changes were saved.
errors.clockUnavailable: The current time is unavailable. No correction was saved.
errors.saveFailed: The correction could not be saved. No partial changes were kept.
